verdicts.reason: The two candidates are visually the same. In both, the robot vacuum is cropped into an unrecognisable dark smear, and the purple circle that holds the text in the original is cut down to a stray purple stub at the far left with no connection to the copy. The white frame line is gone. 'Smart Home' wraps awkwardly onto two lines and sits on top of the dot pattern on a busy photo, so the left half of the banner is dead space while the text is crowded to the right.
